name: Demographics as Destiny: Globalization and the Resurgence of Religion Through Fertility.
headline: Demographics as Destiny: Globalization and the Resurgence of Religion Through Fertility.
description: The article focuses on reduction in fertility rate in globalization conditions that leads to changes in demographic transition with population recession conditions; and assessment of religious demography conditions with assessment of religious resurgence processes.
